messages.subject: Country Manager, ABL Thailand | Country leadership, growth and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear ABL Thailand and APAC Leadership Team,

I am writing in direct response to the Country Manager, ABL Thailand opportunity in Siracha, currently listed under reference ablgroup/TP/918/317.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My career has developed around country-facing leadership, government and regulator engagement, strategic stakeholders, business continuity, ESG and executive coordination in complex industrial environments. I work across senior management, public institutions, contractors, communities and technical teams.

My background is not that of a marine surveyor, and I would not present it as such. The value I bring is complementary: country leadership, client and institutional access, business development discipline, regulated energy and mining exposure, stakeholder risk management, and the ability to help technical specialists convert relationships and market intelligence into durable growth. My recent experience also includes major solar and battery-storage transition work and carbon-data governance.

If ABL is open to a Country Manager profile that combines strong technical teams with a commercially focused, government-facing and stakeholder-led country executive, I would value a discussion. I have attached an ABL Thailand-focused executive CV for immediate review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
